Build, 53 unit-test packages and 102 integration tests pass; the new behaviour itself is not covered by existing tests. - **Schema**: new migration adds a nullable `entries.word_count int` column. hello

world

`, count as one word. - **Reading**: `fetchEntries` selects `e.word_count` into the new `WordCount *int` field on `model.Entry`, so it serialises as an integer or null. - **Client**: `client.Entry` gained the same `WordCount *int` field. The new helper `countContentWords` has no `@effects` tag, since `StripTags` itself is untagged.
